States: 0 idle, 1 begin, 2 extend, 3 commit. Inactive AppMode → return, state untouched.

| old | r | allowed | new | cmd |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| any | 0 | — | 0 | — |
| 0,3 | 3 | — | 0 | — |
| 1,2 | 3 | — | 3 | Commit(3) |
| 0,3 | 1,2 | no | 0 | — |
| 0,3 | 1,2 | yes | 1 | Begin(draw=!erase, s=.5, r=brush) |
| 1,2 | 1,2 | no | 2 | — |
| 1,2 | 1,2 | yes | 2 | pinned shape + Extend(2) |

Surprises: default drag=2 → r=0 → unconditional reset, so a live stroke is dropped with no Commit; only tag≥2 + matching widget draws. u8(drag−2) underflows when drag<2 → r=3 → spurious Commit. Extend mutates state *before* the allowed check; Begin encodes it as state=allowed. 1/2 collapse to 2. erase forces allowed; the draw border test uses 0.32·brush, roughly a third of the brush, so paint may spill outside.

Leave border: state stays 2, no Extend — the stroke freezes, never cancelled. Reenter: Extend(2) resumes from the last in-border point, bridging the excursion with a straight chord across the disallowed region — no break, no re-Begin. Losing the tag/widget mid-excursion → drag=2 → r=0 → state 0, stroke silently lost. erase toggled mid-stroke re-allows but cannot flip draw/erase, since Extend carries no flag.
